game_info.title: Dungeons & Dragons 5th Edition (2024 Rules)
game_info.description: D&D 5e 2024 (5.5e) updated rules with Weapon Mastery, reorganized spell lists, Bastions, and origin feats.

strength.description: Physical power, melee attack, and damage.

charisma.description: Personality, persuasiveness, and force of personality.

dice_system.description: D&D uses a d20 (20-sided die) as the core mechanic. Roll d20 + modifier vs target number (DC or AC).
dice_system.natural_20: Automatic hit on attack rolls (critical hit)

combat.initiative: Roll d20 + Dexterity modifier, highest goes first

turn_actions.action: One action per turn (Attack, Cast a Spell, Dash, Disengage, Hide, Help, Ready, Retreat, Use an Object)
turn_actions.bonus_action: One bonus action per turn if available (specific abilities grant bonus actions)
turn_actions.movement: Move up to your speed in any direction
turn_actions.free_action: One free interaction with the environment (e.g., open a door, draw a weapon)

combat.attack_roll: d20 + attack bonus vs Armor Class (AC)
combat.saving_throws: d20 + ability modifier + proficiency bonus (if proficient) vs DC
combat.ability_checks: d20 + ability modifier + proficiency bonus (if proficient) vs DC

weapon_mastery.description: New 2024 rule: Each weapon has mastery properties that grant special effects when a character with Weapon Mastery hits with that weapon. Replaces the 2014 rule where martial weapon users could add proficiency bonus to damage.

amber.description: When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can make the target have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws against the next spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

blue.description: When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can make the target have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of your next turn.

crimson.description: When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can cause the target to have vulnerability to the next weapon attack you make against it before the end of your next turn.

emerald.description: When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can heal yourself for an amount equal to your proficiency bonus.

gold.description: When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the target up to 10 feet away from you.

green.description: When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can give the target resistance to all damage until the end of your next turn.

orange.description: When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can give yourself resistance to the next damage you take before the end of your next turn.

purple.description: When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can pull the target up to 10 feet closer to you.

ruby.description: When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can give yourself advantage on the next attack roll you make before the end of your next turn.

silver.description: When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can give yourself advantage on the next saving throw you make before the end of your next turn.

violet.description: When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can give yourself advantage on the next ability check you make before the end of your next turn.

white.description: When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can give yourself advantage on the next Dexterity saving throw you make before the end of your next turn.

longsword.description: Versatile weapon with control and push capabilities.

longbow.description: Ranged weapon with control and debuff capabilities.

greatsword.description: Heavy weapon with vulnerability and push capabilities.

rapier.description: Finesse weapon with debuff and pull capabilities.

handaxe.description: Light weapon with defense and offense capabilities.

spell_lists.description: 2024 revision reorganizes spells into three lists: Arcane, Divine, and Primal (replacing Wizard, Sorcerer, Warlock, Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger lists).

arcane.description: Spells of arcane magic, available to Wizards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, and Bards.

divine.description: Spells of divine magic, available to Clerics, Paladins, and some other divine casters.

primal.description: Spells of primal magic, available to Druids, Rangers, and some other primal casters.

origin_feats.description: 2024 revision replaces racial traits with Origin Feats. Each race grants an origin feat that provides unique abilities, replacing the old racial ability score increases and traits.

benefits: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed
Magic can't put you to sleep
Fey Ancestry: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.
Stonecunning: Double proficiency bonus on History checks related to stone
Weapon Training: Proficiency with battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, and warhammer
Reroll 1s on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws
Brave: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened
Halfling Nimbleness: Can move through any space larger than a creature of the next size category
Breath Weapon: Recharge 5-6, cone or line of damage
Damage Resistance: Resistance to the damage type of your breath weapon
Dragon Fear: As a bonus action, frighten creatures within 30 feet
Hellish Resistance: Resistance to fire damage
Infernal Legacy: Can cast hellish rebuke as a 1st-level spell

bastions.description: 2024 revision introduces Bastions - bases of operations that provide benefits to the party. Replaces the old stronghold rules.

urban.description: A city-based headquarters, providing access to information, contacts, and resources.
benefits: Access to local information and rumors

rural.description: A countryside estate, providing access to land, resources, and rural contacts.

wilderness.description: A wilderness camp or outpost, providing access to the wild and survival resources.

barbarian.description: Fierce warriors who channel rage into combat prowess.
key_features: Rage: Enter a furious state, gaining damage resistance and bonus damage
Unarmored Defense: AC = 10 + Dexterity modifier + Constitution modifier
Reckless Attack: Gain advantage on attack rolls, but attackers have advantage against you
Danger Sense: Advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects you can see
Divine Sense: Detect celestial, fiend, or undead within 60 feet
Divine Smite: Expend spell slot to deal extra radiant damage on melee hit

bard.description: Versatile performers who use magic through music and speech.
key_features: Spellcasting: Arcane spellcaster using Charisma
Bardic Inspiration: Inspire allies with performance, granting bonus damage or saving throws
Jack of All Trades: Add half proficiency bonus to ability checks without proficiency
Song of Rest: Restore additional hit points during short rest

cleric.description: Divine spellcasters who channel the power of their deity.
key_features: Spellcasting: Divine spellcaster using Wisdom
Divine Domain: Choose a domain that grants additional spells and features
Channel Divinity: Use divine power for special effects
Destroy Undead: Instantly destroy undead of a certain challenge rating or lower

druid.description: Nature spellcasters who draw power from the natural world.
key_features: Spellcasting: Primal spellcaster using Wisdom
Druidic: Secret language of druids
Wild Shape: Transform into beasts and other creatures
Druid Circle: Choose a circle that grants additional features

fighter.description: Mastered warriors proficient with weapons and armor.
key_features: Fighting Style: Choose a style that grants a combat bonus
Second Wind: Recover hit points as a bonus action
Action Surge: Take an additional action on your turn
Martial Archetype: Choose an archetype that defines your fighting style

monk.description: Martial artists who channel ki energy into combat.
key_features: Unarmored Defense: AC = 10 + Dexterity modifier + Wisdom modifier
Martial Arts: Use Dexterity for melee attacks, bonus action attack
Ki Points: Pool of points to fuel special abilities
Flurry of Blows: Spend ki points for bonus action attacks
Step of the Wind: Spend ki points for bonus action Dash or Disengage

paladin.description: Holy warriors who fight for justice and righteousness.
key_features: Divine Sense: Detect celestial, fiend, or undead within 60 feet
Divine Smite: Expend spell slot to deal extra radiant damage on melee hit
Spellcasting: Divine spellcaster using Charisma
Fighting Style: Choose a style that grants a combat bonus
Sacred Oath: Choose an oath that grants additional features

ranger.description: Skilled hunters and trackers who protect the frontier.
key_features: Favored Enemy: Advantage on tracking and learning about certain creatures
Natural Explorer: Advantage on certain exploration checks
Spellcasting: Primal spellcaster using Wisdom
Ranger Archetype: Choose an archetype that defines your ranger style

rogue.description: Skilled thieves and scouts who excel in stealth and precision.
key_features: Sneak Attack: Deal extra damage when attacking with advantage or an ally adjacent to the target
Thieves' Cant: Secret language of rogues
Cunning Action: Bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide
Roguish Archetype: Choose an archetype that defines your rogue style

sorcerer.description: Innate spellcasters who draw magic from their bloodline.
key_features: Spellcasting: Arcane spellcaster using Charisma
Sorcerous Origin: Choose an origin that grants additional features
Font of Magic: Pool of sorcery points to fuel special abilities
Metamagic: Modify spells in various ways

warlock.description: Spellcasters who draw power from a patron.
key_features: Pact Magic: Arcane spellcaster using Charisma, with limited spell slots that refresh on short rest
Otherworldly Patron: Choose a patron that grants additional features
Pact Boon: Choose a boon from your patron
Eldritch Invocations: Special abilities that enhance your magic

wizard.description: Scholarly spellcasters who study and master arcane magic.
key_features: Spellcasting: Arcane spellcaster using Intelligence
Arcane Recovery: Recover spell slots once per day
Arcane Tradition: Choose a tradition that grants additional features
Spellbook: Collection of spells that can be prepared

magic_items.description: Magic items are objects with magical properties. 2024 revision introduces attunement slots and rarity tiers.

rarity.common: No attunement required, minor magical effects
rarity.uncommon: No attunement required, moderate magical effects
rarity.rare: Attunement may be required, significant magical effects
rarity.legendary: Attunement required, extremely powerful magical effects
rarity.artifact: Attunement required, unique and powerful items with special properties

attunement.description: Some magic items require attunement to use. A creature can attune to a maximum of 3 magic items.
process: Hold the item during a short rest
Form a bond with the item

weapon.vorpal_sword: Chance to decapitate on critical hit

armor.armor_of_versatility: +1 to AC, add proficiency bonus to AC if unarmored
armor.dragon_scale_mail: AC 15 + Dexterity modifier (max 2), resistance to slashing, piercing, and bludgeoning

wondrous.boots_of_speed: Double movement speed, advantage on Dexterity saving throws
